about: REAL SIZE per prop kind (docs/world-standards/props.md 'Real size per kind'). Each kind matches prefab names (the last path segment, - and _ read as spaces) and bounds one dimension of the DECLARED size, in metres, for a HUMAN user (1.8 m). For another scale class the range scales by that class's height over 1.8 (dressing vocabulary). dim: h = height (Y), long = the longer horizontal side, max = the largest side. `props status` flags a prop outside its range; `dress check` refuses placing one (wrong-size) at the place's scale. A project extends, overrides or drops (null) a kind in authoring/prop-catalogs.json `realSize.kinds`; a catalogue row may set `realSizeExempt: "<why>"` (a toy, a model, a deliberate oversize with its own model).

barrel.note: a cask to a large barrel; a vat is not a barrel

tent.note: a pup tent a body crawls into to a tall pavilion

door.note: about 2 m for its user; a grand door up to 3.2 m

chain.note: a barrier chain hangs about waist-high; a chain lying down is flat

chair.note: a plain seat to a high-backed chair

banner.note: cloth (+ its pole or rod): a short shop-front flag to a pole banner standing taller than a man

wall hanging.note: a cloth hung flat on a wall from a rod

painting.note: frame included: a small panel to a hall's large canvas

mirror.note: frame included: a hand-sized wall glass to a tall pier glass
